rows.essential_qualification: Three years regular Engineering Diploma OR four-year regular course in B.E./B.Tech, in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Computer Science/Information Technology, obtained from a University/Institution recognized by UGC, AICTE, or any other Government-recognized accrediting body.

M.E./M.Tech. in Safety Engineering along with B.E./B.Tech. in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering; OR B.E./B.Tech. in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering along with a one-year full-time Degree/Diploma in Safety; OR B.E./B.Tech. in Fire & Safety Engineering. Minimum CGPA of 6.0 or 60% marks required, from a Government-recognized University/Institution approved by UGC/AICTE or any other competent Government authority.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Supervisor Key Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Supervisor-S&T: Installation/Maintenance of CCTV/PA system/FOTS/AFC systems. Supervisor-Safety: Responsible for all Safety department related works pertaining to the DMRC Project at Mumbai Metro. Supervisor-Civil: Supervision of construction works of Metro Viaduct, stations building, finishing works, PEB works, estimation, billing, planning, etc.

faq.question: Q1. What is BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited under Vacancy Advertisement No. 558, for engagement of Supervisor-S&T, Supervisor-Safety and Supervisor-Civil on a one-year contractual basis for deployment at DMRC/DMIL, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies in total: 02 for Supervisor-S&T, 02 for Supervisor-Safety, and 06 for Supervisor-Civil. The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease as per requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 06.10.2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BECIL Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: an Engineering Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Computer Science/IT for Supervisor-S&T; a Safety Engineering qualification combined with Civil/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or Fire & Safety Engineering for Supervisor-Safety; and an Engineering Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering for Supervisor-Civil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 33 years for Supervisor-S&T, and 40 years for both Supervisor-Safety and Supervisor-Civil.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application processing fee is NIL for SC/ST and PWD candidates, and Rs. 295/- for all other categories.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through becilregistration.in by completing the registration, filling in personal and other details, and making the payment to submit the application.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BECIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized and shortlisted based on eligibility criteria, and the shortlist is forwarded to the Client/Principal Employer (DMRC) for further stages such as interview, assessment, or skill test as decided by the Client.
